label: Whatever moves another only as moved is, in that, an efficient…, from occasionalist refutation
meaning: Every per se mover link is a per se cause link, from the conclusion of NO-OCCASIONALIST-MOVER-LINK-WITHOUT-CAUSE-FROM-EFFICIENT-MOVERS (no y moves x as moved without causing x as caused, on the same MovesAsMoved and CausesAsCaused) and excluded middle. The refutation's premises (the per se mover-link analysis, every mover is an efficient cause, second efficient causes cause only as caused) stay OPEN; nothing about the identity of the two relations is claimed beyond inclusion.
